integrity: A complete finite enumerator, an independent count algorithm for lengths 13 to 26, and direct inverse/forward BWT witness checks are supplied. The work makes no general all-length conjecture claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite results for lengths 13 to 30; no unbounded construction. Exact counts refer to a fixed ordered ternary alphabet only. Numeric sharpness for lengths 13, 28, 29 was already implied by a published arithmetic construction. The independently implemented full recount covers lengths 13 through 26; longer counts rely on the primary exhaustive enumerator, with all displayed witnesses independently checked. Priority and mathematical validation by an independent reviewer have not been performed.
title: Exact sharpness census for completely unclustered ternary Burrows–Wheeler images through length 30
